name: ai-command
description: Natural language to shell command using the AI configured in Settings → AI: "AI: Generate Command" in the palette (or a "??" quick-switcher query) types the generated command at the prompt for review — never runs it.

aiCommand.aiProfile.description: Which configured AI turns a request into a shell command. “App default” follows Settings → AI's own default; a small, fast model is usually enough for one command.

aiCommand.aiModel.description: Model for turning a request into a command. Empty uses whatever model the AI above is configured with.
